_note: Reviewed matches, pinned by a truncated SHA-256 of the matched value.
Fingerprints rather than (path, rule): with only the pair, a file exempted
for one key silently covered every later key of the same shape pasted into
it, which is the case this scan exists to catch. The digest identifies a hit
An entry matching nothing fails the scan, so stale exemptions surface.

allow.reason: Fixture value the bringup test writes into a throwaway .env to prove the script never echoes a credential. The literal has to be present for that test to mean anything.
